name: Augment Swap
description: Two volunteers — one heavily augmented, one aug-free — exchange their full suite of installed hardware for seven days, captured in documentary-style holographic broadcast. The show oscillates between genuine human interest and exploitation, as the aug-free participants struggle with sudden sensory overload while the augmented participants rediscover biological vulnerability. Season 4 featured a Tier 1 Shelf resident swapping with a Tier 4 HelixCorp logistics manager and became the most-watched single episode in the show's history.
cultural_impact: Augment Swap made chrome inequality viscerally legible to middle-tier audiences in a way that political arguments never had.
story_hooks: The unedited Season 2 death footage has resurfaced, and both the victim's family and Vantablack Media's legal division are racing to control it.
A participant from Season 6 refuses to return the aug hardware at the end of the swap week — they've discovered it contains data caches from their partner's employer.
A Flatskin activist applies to appear on the show as a political statement; the production team wants them removed before broadcast, but the episode has already been teased.
